title: MV YEP Animated Sideview Enemies - Weapon Image Not Appearing

posts.author: LunarMelodia
posts.body:
Hi all,
I've had this trouble for months now and have tried pretty extensively to fix it, with no luck.
In Yanfly's Animated Sideview Enemies plugin, you can assign Weapon Images to enemies using
<Weapon Image: int>
, and assign Weapon Motions using
<Weapon Motion: string>
My project has a ton of animated enemies that use the same sprite sheets as Actors, so having these weapons and weapon motions display for enemy attacks is really neat because it gives the illusion of enemies having diverse weapons.
This plugin worked completely fine for a while, but at some point that I can't quite remember (perhaps an engine update?) the weapon images just stopped showing up. The motions work completely fine, and the images show up on my Actors, but not my Enemies.
Above you'll see this boss enemy 'Magnus' is supposed to be wielding a spear, and while the
<Weapon Motion: thrust>
is working just fine, the
<Weapon Image: 12>
is not showing up.
This is what Magnus's notetag box looks like...
As below, #12
should
be assigned to Spear.
I have not modified the Weapons image files in the System folder, everything is default in that regard.
When Leon attacks with a Spear equipped, it calls the default 'Attack' skill which reads
motion attack: user
in its action sequence.
Doing this actually does display his spear as seen below.
motion attack
is reading the image and motion from the equipped weapon, which in Leon's case is a Spear.
Enemies can't have 'weapons' equipped, which is why this plugin has notetags to manually display weapon images and perform motions.
But while the motion
is
working, the images are not displaying.
It doesn't matter what I change it to. Dagger, mace, staff, sword, bow. None of them work for
enemies
, yet all of them work fine for Actors.
I know this is elaborate and confusing but I don't know how else to explain it and its been driving me up the wall for months now.
Does anyone have any ideas or suggestions?
Edit:
I also want to point out that
motion thrust: user
is currently in Magnus's action sequence for his attack skill. But if I replace it with
motion attack: user
instead (the one Leon uses) instead
no motion
is played at all.

From the looks everything though it seems you are doing all the right things. If it worked before and you didn't change anything like add new plugins for other things in your game and didn't mess around with the note tag stuff it should be working. Adding new plugins for other things in your game for sure can mess up other plugins because sometimes they don't work good together so check that. Try turning off plugins one at a time and see if your weapons work.
I don't think Yanfly updates older plugin's anymore so it shouldn't be a plugin update error but yeah could be game update, so the plugin doesn't work with the newer update.

Just to mention it, you should probably not be using both whole and target actions.
The whole action is for something that affects all targets simultaneously whereas the target action affects all targets in sequence.
If it's a single-target skill, there's no reason to be using both of those - choose one and put everything there (the target action is better practice).
LunarMelodia said:
I have absolutely no idea why its not working for me, but is for the two of you.
Click to expand...
Robro's suggestion of double-checking your plugin versions is a good one. I would add to that checking your MV version (found at the top of rpg_core.js).
Additionally, have you done anything to modify your MV installation, such as changing your NW.js version?
